source.text: וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֗וּ רָאשֵׁי֙ אֲב֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And approached [the] heads of [the] fathers of the Levites to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua son of Nun and to [the] heads of [the] fathers of the tribes of [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And the heads of the fathers of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: The family heads of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun and to the family heads of the tribes of Israel.
en.R: The leaders of the Levite families went to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun and to the leaders of the families in the tribes of Israel.

sw.L: Na wakuu wa baba wa Walawi wakamkaribia Eleazari kuhani na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na wakuu wa baba wa makabila ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Wakuu wa jamaa za Walawi walimwendea Eleazari kuhani, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na wakuu wa jamaa za makabila ya Israeli.
sw.R: Viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi walikwenda kwa Eleazari kuhani, kwa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na kwa viongozi wa jamaa katika makabila ya Israeli.

decisions.choice: the heads of the fathers: the heads of the ancestral families
decisions.reason: "House of the fathers" is the Hebrew name for an extended family traced through its male line; "heads of the fathers" is short for the heads of such families. The same leaders, with Eleazar and Joshua, shared out the land (14:1; 19:51).

decisions.choice: the Levites come to claim what Moses had commanded
decisions.reason: The land has now been divided among the tribes (chapters 14-19) and the cities of refuge named (chapter 20). The Levites, who received no territory of their own (13:14, 33; 14:3-4), come to ask for the towns promised them in Numbers 35:1-8.

decisions.choice: family heads (Balanced) / leaders of the families (Readable)
decisions.reason: The plain sense of the title, as in 14:1; Literal keeps the Hebrew form.

source.text: וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם בְּשִׁלֹ֗ה בְּאֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֨עַן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה בְיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽתֶת־לָ֥נוּ עָרִ֖ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֖ן לִבְהֶמְתֵּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in [the] land of Canaan, saying, Yahweh commanded by [the] hand of Moses to give to us cities to dwell [in] and their pasture lands for our livestock.

en.L: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell [in], and their pasturelands for our livestock."
en.B: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan and said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} commanded through Moses that we be given towns to live in, and their pasturelands for our livestock."
en.R: At Shiloh in the land of Canaan they said to them, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave a command through Moses. He said that we should be given towns to live in, and their pasturelands for our animals."

sw.L: Na wakasema nao huko Shilo katika nchi ya Kanaani, wakisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru kwa mkono wa Musa tupewe miji ya kukaa, na malisho yake kwa ajili ya mifugo yetu."
sw.B: Walisema nao huko Shilo katika nchi ya Kanaani, wakasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru kupitia Musa kwamba tupewe miji ya kuishi, pamoja na malisho yake kwa ajili ya mifugo yetu."
sw.R: Huko Shilo katika nchi ya Kanaani waliwaambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alitoa amri kupitia Musa. Alisema kwamba tupewe miji ya kuishi, pamoja na malisho yake kwa ajili ya wanyama wetu."

decisions.choice: Shiloh: where the tent of meeting stood
decisions.reason: Israel had set up the tent of meeting at Shiloh, and the last lots for the land were cast there before the LORD (18:1, 8-10; 19:51).

decisions.choice: by the hand of Moses: through Moses
decisions.reason: The "hand" of a person is the means by which something is done. The LORD gave the command, and Moses was the one who passed it on.

decisions.choice: pasturelands: the open land around a town, kept for grazing
decisions.reason: The word names the common land just outside a town, used for the townspeople's herds and flocks, not for houses or crops (Numbers 35:2-5). The pasturelands of the Levites' towns could never be sold (Leviticus 25:34).

decisions.choice: the command of Numbers 35:1-8
decisions.reason: The LORD told Moses that the tribes were to give the Levites forty-eight towns with their pasturelands, more from the large tribes and fewer from the small (Numbers 35:1-8). This chapter tells how that was done.

decisions.choice: cities / towns; "X and its pasturelands" kept the same at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word covers places of any size; most of these were small walled settlements, so Balanced and Readable say "towns", as in 14:4. The phrase "and its pasturelands" repeats after every name in the lists that follow, and it is kept word for word the same each time so the list reads as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "X na malisho yake" at every level
decisions.reason: "Malisho" are the grazing lands around a town. Swahili uses the same phrase at every level through the list of the Levites' towns, as the English keeps "X and its pasturelands".

source.text: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לַלְוִיִּ֛ם מִנַּחֲלָתָ֖ם אֶל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave [the] sons of Israel to the Levites from their inheritance by [the] mouth of Yahweh the cities the these and their pasture lands.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel gave to the Levites from their inheritance, at the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, these cities and their pasturelands.
en.B: So at the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} gave the Levites the following towns and their pasturelands out of their own inheritance.
en.R: So, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} gave the Levites some of their own land. They gave the towns listed below and their pasturelands.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli wakawapa Walawi kutoka urithi wao, kwa kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, miji hii na malisho yake.
sw.B: Basi kwa agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Waisraeli waliwapa Walawi miji ifuatayo pamoja na malisho yake kutoka katika urithi wao wenyewe.
sw.R: Basi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameamuru, Waisraeli waliwapa Walawi sehemu ya nchi yao wenyewe. Waliwapa miji iliyoorodheshwa hapa chini pamoja na malisho yake.

decisions.choice: by the mouth of the LORD: at the LORD's command
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what someone says. The tribes give up these towns because the LORD said so, not by their own choice alone.

decisions.choice: from their inheritance: out of the land each tribe had received
decisions.reason: The towns came out of the tribes' own lasting shares of the land, so each tribe gave up something of what it held.

decisions.choice: these cities: points ahead to the list
decisions.reason: "These" looks forward to the towns named in verses 9-40.

decisions.choice: the following / listed below
decisions.reason: Makes clear that "these" refers to the towns about to be named.

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י וַיְהִ֡י לִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יְ֠הוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֜י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה בִנְיָמִן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And came out the lot for [the] clans of the Kohathites, and were for [the] sons of Aaron the priest, from the Levites, from [the] tribe of Judah and from [the] tribe of the Simeonite and from [the] tribe of Benjamin, by the lot, cities thirteen.

en.L: And the lot came out for the clans of the Kohathites; and the sons of Aaron the priest, of the Levites, had from the tribe of Judah and from the tribe of the Simeonites and from the tribe of Benjamin, by lot, thirteen cities.
en.B: The lot came out for the clans of the Kohathites. The descendants of Aaron the priest, who were among the Levites, received thirteen towns by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.
en.R: When lots were cast, one came out for the clans of Kohath. The descendants of Aaron the priest, who belonged to the Levites, received thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.

sw.L: Na kura ikatoka kwa koo za Wakohathi; na wana wa Haruni kuhani, wa Walawi, walipata kutoka kabila la Yuda na kutoka kabila la Wasimeoni na kutoka kabila la Benyamini, kwa kura, miji kumi na mitatu.
sw.B: Kura ilitoka kwa koo za Wakohathi. Wazao wa Haruni kuhani, waliokuwa miongoni mwa Walawi, walipokea kwa kura miji kumi na mitatu kutoka makabila ya Yuda, Simeoni na Benyamini.
sw.R: Kura zilipopigwa, moja ilitoka kwa koo za Kohathi. Wazao wa Haruni kuhani, waliokuwa wa Walawi, walipokea miji kumi na mitatu kutoka makabila ya Yuda, Simeoni na Benyamini.

decisions.choice: the Kohathites: one of the three Levite clan groups
decisions.reason: The Levites were descended from Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath and Merari (Numbers 3:17), and the chapter is ordered by these three groups. Aaron belonged to Kohath's line (Exodus 6:18-20), so his descendants, the priests, are listed first and apart from the other Kohathites.

decisions.choice: the lot came out: the share was decided by drawing lots
decisions.reason: As with the land itself, the towns were assigned by lot, so the outcome was left to the LORD rather than to the leaders' preference (Numbers 26:55-56; Proverbs 16:33).

decisions.choice: the tribe of the Simeonite: the tribe of Simeon
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew uses the clan name, "the Simeonite", in place of "Simeon"; it means the same tribe.

decisions.choice: descendants of Aaron
decisions.reason: "Sons" here means the whole priestly line descended from Aaron, so Balanced and Readable say "descendants"; Literal keeps "sons".

source.text: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מַטֵּֽה־אֶ֠פְרַיִם וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־דָ֞ן וּמֵחֲצִ֨י מַטֵּ֧ה מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And for [the] sons of Kohath the remaining, from [the] clans of [the] tribe of Ephraim and from [the] tribe of Dan and from [the] half of [the] tribe of Manasseh, by the lot, cities ten.

en.L: And the rest of the sons of Kohath [had] from the clans of the tribe of Ephraim and from the tribe of Dan and from the half of the tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
en.B: The rest of the descendants of Kohath received ten towns by lot from the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, from the tribe of Dan and from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
en.R: The rest of Kohath's descendants received ten towns from the tribes of Ephraim and Dan and from half the tribe of Manasseh.

sw.L: Na wana wa Kohathi waliobaki [walipata] kutoka koo za kabila la Efraimu na kutoka kabila la Dani na kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase, kwa kura, miji kumi.
sw.B: Wazao wengine wa Kohathi walipokea kwa kura miji kumi kutoka koo za kabila la Efraimu, kutoka kabila la Dani na kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase.
sw.R: Wazao wengine wa Kohathi walipokea miji kumi kutoka makabila ya Efraimu na Dani na kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase.

decisions.choice: the remaining: the Kohathites who were not descended from Aaron
decisions.reason: Verse 4 dealt with the priests; "the rest" are the other Kohathite families, who served at the sanctuary but were not priests (Numbers 4:1-15).

decisions.choice: the half of the tribe of Manasseh: here the half west of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Manasseh's land lay on both sides of the Jordan (13:29-31; 17:1-13). The towns given from it in verse 25, Taanach and Gath-rimmon, are in the western half.

decisions.choice: received
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb ("to the sons of Kohath ... ten cities"); "received" supplies it, as "had" does in brackets at Literal.

source.text: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת מַטֵּֽה־יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּמִמַּטֵּֽה־אָ֠שֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י וּ֠מֵחֲצִי מַטֵּ֨ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בַבָּשָׁן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And for [the] sons of Gershon, from [the] clans of [the] tribe of Issachar and from [the] tribe of Asher and from [the] tribe of Naphtali and from [the] half of [the] tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, by the lot, cities thirteen.

en.L: And the sons of Gershon [had] from the clans of the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naphtali and from the half of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, by lot, thirteen cities.
en.B: The descendants of Gershon received thirteen towns by lot from the clans of the tribe of Issachar, from the tribes of Asher and Naphtali and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
en.R: Gershon's descendants received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali and from half the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

sw.L: Na wana wa Gershoni [walipata] kutoka koo za kabila la Isakari na kutoka kabila la Asheri na kutoka kabila la Naftali na kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase katika Bashani, kwa kura, miji kumi na mitatu.
sw.B: Wazao wa Gershoni walipokea kwa kura miji kumi na mitatu kutoka koo za kabila la Isakari, kutoka makabila ya Asheri na Naftali na kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase katika Bashani.
sw.R: Wazao wa Gershoni walipokea miji kumi na mitatu kutoka makabila ya Isakari, Asheri na Naftali na kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase huko Bashani.

decisions.choice: Bashan: the land east of the Jordan and north of Gilead
decisions.reason: Bashan was the kingdom of Og that Moses gave to half the tribe of Manasseh (13:29-31). With it, the Gershonites' towns all lie in the north of the land.

decisions.choice: for the sons of Gershon: the second Levite clan group
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, the Hebrew has no verb; the towns belonged to them by lot.

source.text: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֨ה רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] sons of Merari according to their clans, from [the] tribe of Reuben and from [the] tribe of Gad and from [the] tribe of Zebulun, cities twelve.

en.L: For the sons of Merari according to their clans [were] from the tribe of Reuben and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zebulun twelve cities.
en.B: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.
en.R: Merari's descendants, clan by clan, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

sw.L: Kwa wana wa Merari kufuatana na koo zao [ilikuwa] kutoka kabila la Reubeni na kutoka kabila la Gadi na kutoka kabila la Zabuloni miji kumi na miwili.
sw.B: Wazao wa Merari, ukoo kwa ukoo, walipokea miji kumi na miwili kutoka makabila ya Reubeni, Gadi na Zabuloni.
sw.R: Wazao wa Merari, ukoo kwa ukoo, walipokea miji kumi na miwili kutoka makabila ya Reubeni, Gadi na Zabuloni.

decisions.choice: Merari: the third Levite clan group
decisions.reason: Reuben and Gad lay east of the Jordan and Zebulun in the north. The twelve towns are listed in verses 34-39, four from each tribe.

decisions.choice: according to their clans: clan by clan
decisions.reason: The towns were shared out among the separate clans of Merari's line (Numbers 3:33).

source.text: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בַּגּוֹרָֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And gave [the] sons of Israel to the Levites the cities the these and their pasture lands, as commanded Yahweh by [the] hand of Moses, by the lot.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded by the hand of Moses, by lot.
en.B: So the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} gave these towns and their pasturelands to the Levites by lot, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded through Moses.
en.R: So the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} used lots to give these towns and their pasturelands to the Levites. This was what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded through Moses.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli wakawapa Walawi miji hii na malisho yake, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameamuru kwa mkono wa Musa, kwa kura.
sw.B: Hivyo Waisraeli waliwapa Walawi miji hii pamoja na malisho yake kwa kura, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameamuru kupitia Musa.
sw.R: Hivyo Waisraeli walipiga kura ili kuwapa Walawi miji hii pamoja na malisho yake. Hivyo ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameamuru kupitia Musa.

decisions.choice: a summary that closes the overview
decisions.reason: Verses 4-7 give the totals for each group; this verse sums them up, repeating verse 3, before the towns are named one by one from verse 9.

decisions.choice: by the hand of Moses: through Moses
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

source.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ מִמַּטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן אֵ֚ת הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן בְּשֵֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they gave from [the] tribe of [the] sons of Judah and from [the] tribe of [the] sons of Simeon the cities the these which one called them by name.

en.L: And they gave from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon these cities that are [here] called by name.
en.B: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they gave the towns that are named below.
en.R: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they gave the towns that are named here.

sw.L: Na wakatoa kutoka kabila la wana wa Yuda na kutoka kabila la wana wa Simeoni miji hii inayotajwa [hapa] kwa majina.
sw.B: Kutoka makabila ya Yuda na Simeoni walitoa miji inayotajwa kwa majina hapa chini.
sw.R: Kutoka makabila ya Yuda na Simeoni walitoa miji inayotajwa hapa.

decisions.choice: which one called by name: which are mentioned by name
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject ("he called"); it is an impersonal way of saying that the towns are about to be listed by name.

decisions.choice: the tribe of the sons of Judah: the tribe of Judah
decisions.reason: "Sons of Judah" here is the tribe as a whole. Simeon's land lay inside Judah's (19:1, 9), which is why the two are counted together.

decisions.choice: named below / named here
decisions.reason: The plain sense of the impersonal phrase.

source.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַקְּהָתִ֖י מִבְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֛ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל רִיאשֹׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was for [the] sons of Aaron, from [the] clans of the Kohathite, from [the] sons of Levi, for to them was the lot first.

en.L: And [they] were for the sons of Aaron, of the clans of the Kohathites, of the sons of Levi, for theirs was the first lot.
en.B: They went to the descendants of Aaron, who belonged to the Kohathite clans among the Levites, because the first lot fell to them.
en.R: These towns went to Aaron's descendants, who were part of the Kohathite clans of the Levites. Their lot was the first one drawn.

sw.L: Na [ilikuwa] kwa wana wa Haruni, wa koo za Wakohathi, wa wana wa Lawi, kwa maana kura ya kwanza ilikuwa yao.
sw.B: Miji hiyo iliwaendea wazao wa Haruni, waliokuwa wa koo za Wakohathi kati ya Walawi, kwa sababu kura ya kwanza iliwaangukia wao.
sw.R: Miji hiyo iliwaendea wazao wa Haruni, waliokuwa sehemu ya koo za Wakohathi za Walawi. Kura yao ndiyo iliyopigwa kwanza.

decisions.choice: it was: these towns belonged
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says simply "it was for the sons of Aaron"; the subject is the towns named in verse 9.

decisions.choice: the first lot was theirs
decisions.reason: The priests' share was drawn first, which explains why they are listed first. The Hebrew can also be read "for the lot was theirs first"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: They went / These towns went
decisions.reason: Supplies the subject the Hebrew leaves to the context.

decisions.choice: Kiriath-arba: the old name of Hebron
decisions.reason: The name means "town of Arba". Joshua 14:15 and 15:13 explain that Arba was the greatest of the Anakim, and that the town later called Hebron was named after him.

decisions.choice: father of the Anak: Arba was the ancestor of the Anakim
decisions.reason: The phrase describes Arba, not the town. The Anakim were the tall people whom the spies feared (Numbers 13:22, 28, 33) and whom Caleb drove out of Hebron (15:14).

decisions.choice: verses 36-37 are read as part of the text
decisions.reason: The Leningrad Codex, the manuscript on which the printed Hebrew text is based, does not have verses 36-37; it goes straight from Zebulun's towns to Gad's. The verses are found in many other Hebrew manuscripts and in the ancient Greek translation, which also calls Bezer "the city of refuge for the killer" and places it "in the wilderness" (as 20:8 and Deuteronomy 4:43 do). The same four towns stand in the parallel list in 1 Chronicles 6:63-64. Without them Merari's towns would number eight, not the twelve of verses 7 and 40, and the total would fall short of the forty-eight of verse 41. They are included, as the edition used here prints them. Reviewers should check the manuscript evidence.

decisions.choice: Bezer: a city of refuge
decisions.reason: Bezer was the southern city of refuge east of the Jordan (20:8; Deuteronomy 4:43). Unlike the other five, it is not called a city of refuge in the Hebrew of this verse.

decisions.choice: Jahaz: where Israel defeated Sihon
decisions.reason: Jahaz is where Sihon king of Heshbon fought Israel and was defeated (Numbers 21:23-24); it is listed in Reuben's land in 13:18.

sw.R: Kutoka kabila la Gadi waliwapa Ramothi katika Gileadi na malisho yake. Ramothi ulikuwa mji wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya mtu aliyeua. Pia waliwapa Mahanaimu na malisho yake.

decisions.choice: the city of refuge: Ramoth in Gilead, named in 20:8
decisions.reason: As in verse 13.

decisions.choice: Mahanaim: on the border of Gad and Manasseh
decisions.reason: Jacob named the place after meeting angels there (Genesis 32:3); it marks the edge of Gad's land (13:26, 30).

decisions.choice: they gave
decisions.reason: As in verse 17.

source.text: אֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־יַעְזֵ֖ר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ כָּל־עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: Heshbon and its pasture lands, Jazer and its pasture lands: all [the] cities four.

en.L: Heshbon and its pasturelands, Jazer and its pasturelands: in all four cities.
en.B: Heshbon and its pasturelands, and Jazer and its pasturelands: four towns in all.
en.R: They also gave Heshbon and its pasturelands, and Jazer and its pasturelands. That made four towns in all.

sw.L: Heshboni na malisho yake, Yazeri na malisho yake: miji yote minne.
sw.B: Heshboni na malisho yake, na Yazeri na malisho yake: jumla miji minne.
sw.R: Pia waliwapa Heshboni na malisho yake, na Yazeri na malisho yake. Hiyo ilikuwa jumla ya miji minne.

decisions.choice: Heshbon and Jazer: towns east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Heshbon had been Sihon's royal city (12:2); Jazer is named in Gad's land (13:25). Both lay in the land Moses took from Sihon.

source.text: כָּל־הֶ֨עָרִ֜ים לִבְנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַיְהִי֙ גּוֹרָלָ֔ם עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: All the cities for [the] sons of Merari according to their clans, the remaining from [the] clans of the Levites; and was their lot cities twelve.

en.L: All the cities for the sons of Merari according to their clans, the rest of the clans of the Levites: their lot was twelve cities.
en.B: All the towns given to the descendants of Merari, clan by clan, the rest of the Levite clans, came by lot to twelve towns.
en.R: So the clans of Merari's descendants, the last of the Levite clans, received twelve towns in all by lot.

sw.L: Miji yote kwa wana wa Merari kufuatana na koo zao, waliobaki wa koo za Walawi: kura yao ilikuwa miji kumi na miwili.
sw.B: Miji yote waliyopewa wazao wa Merari, ukoo kwa ukoo, yaani koo za Walawi zilizobaki, ilifikia kwa kura miji kumi na miwili.
sw.R: Hivyo koo za wazao wa Merari, koo za mwisho za Walawi, zilipokea kwa kura jumla ya miji kumi na miwili.

decisions.choice: twelve: four each from Zebulun, Reuben and Gad
decisions.reason: The total matches verse 7 and counts Reuben's four towns in verses 36-37.

decisions.choice: their lot: the share that fell to them by lot
decisions.reason: "Lot" here stands for the share the lot assigned, as in verse 20.

decisions.choice: the last of the Levite clans
decisions.reason: "The rest" means the group that remained after the others had received their towns.

source.text: כֹּ֚ל עָרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָרִ֛ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] cities of the Levites in [the] midst of [the] possession of [the] sons of Israel: cities forty and eight, and their pasture lands.

en.L: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel [were] forty-eight cities and their pasturelands.
en.B: In all, the Levites had forty-eight towns and their pasturelands within the land held by the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: The Levites had forty-eight towns and their pasturelands in all, spread out through the land that belonged to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

sw.L: Miji yote ya Walawi katikati ya milki ya wana wa Israeli [ilikuwa] miji arobaini na minane na malisho yake.
sw.B: Kwa jumla, Walawi walikuwa na miji arobaini na minane pamoja na malisho yake ndani ya nchi waliyomiliki Waisraeli.
sw.R: Walawi walikuwa na jumla ya miji arobaini na minane pamoja na malisho yake, iliyotawanyika katika nchi yote iliyokuwa ya Waisraeli.

decisions.choice: forty-eight: the number the LORD commanded
decisions.reason: The total matches Numbers 35:7: the six cities of refuge and forty-two others. Thirteen went to the priests, ten to the other Kohathites, thirteen to the Gershonites and twelve to the Merarites.

decisions.choice: in the midst of the possession: among all the tribes
decisions.reason: The Levites had no territory of their own but lived in towns scattered among every tribe's land, so that the tribe set apart to serve the LORD lived among all Israel (Genesis 49:7; Deuteronomy 33:10).

decisions.choice: spread out through
decisions.reason: Brings out "in the midst of": the towns lay among the lands of all the tribes.

source.text: תִּֽהְיֶ֨ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עִ֣יר עִ֔יר וּמִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֖ן לְכָל־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Were the cities the these city city and its pasture lands around it; so for all the cities the these.

en.L: These cities were each city [with] its pasturelands around it; so [it was] for all these cities.
en.B: Each of these towns had its pasturelands around it; it was the same for all of these towns.
en.R: Every one of these towns had pasturelands around it. This was true for all of them.

sw.L: Miji hii ilikuwa kila mji [pamoja na] malisho yake kuuzunguka; ndivyo [ilivyokuwa] kwa miji hii yote.
sw.B: Kila mmoja wa miji hiyo ulikuwa na malisho yake kuuzunguka; ndivyo ilivyokuwa kwa miji hiyo yote.
sw.R: Kila mji kati ya miji hiyo ulikuwa na malisho kuuzunguka. Ndivyo ilivyokuwa kwa miji yote.

decisions.choice: city city: each city
decisions.reason: Repeating the noun gives the sense "every single one". The verse sums up that the grant was the same everywhere: a town together with the grazing land that surrounded it.

decisions.choice: its pasturelands around it
decisions.reason: As in verse 11.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָתֵ֣ת לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּרָשׁ֖וּהָ וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ בָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave Yahweh to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers, and they took possession of it and dwelt in it.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave to Israel all the land which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had sworn to give to their fathers; and they took possession of it and dwelt in it.
en.B: In this way {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Israel the whole land that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had sworn to give to their ancestors, and they took possession of it and settled there.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Israel all the land {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had promised with an oath to give their ancestors. They took it over and made their homes there.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawapa Israeli nchi yote aliyoapa kuwapa baba zao; nao wakaimiliki, wakakaa ndani yake.
sw.B: Hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa Israeli nchi yote aliyokuwa ameapa kuwapa baba zao, nao wakaimiliki, wakakaa humo.
sw.R: Hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa Israeli nchi yote aliyokuwa amewaahidi baba zao kwa kiapo. Waliichukua, wakajenga makao yao humo.

decisions.choice: which he swore to give to their fathers
decisions.reason: The LORD had promised the land on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob (Genesis 12:7; 15:18; 26:3; Exodus 6:8; Deuteronomy 1:8). These closing verses (43-45) look back over the whole book: the promise has been kept.

decisions.choice: all the land: the promise fulfilled, though some places were still unconquered
decisions.reason: The book itself says that land remained to be taken and that some Canaanites still lived among the tribes (13:1-6; 15:63; 16:10; 17:12). The summary speaks of the LORD's side: he gave what he had promised, and Israel's task was to take hold of it (23:4-5).

decisions.choice: took possession of: took the land as their own
decisions.reason: The verb means to take over land and hold it, often by driving out those who held it before.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means the forefathers of the nation, so Balanced and Readable say "ancestors".

source.text: וַיָּ֨נַח יְהוָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־עָ֨מַד אִ֤ישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם֙ מִכָּל־אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave rest Yahweh to them all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers; and not stood a man against them of all their enemies; all their enemies gave Yahweh into their hand.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them rest all around, according to all that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had sworn to their fathers; and not a man of all their enemies stood before them; all their enemies {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave into their hand.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave them rest all around them, in keeping with everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had sworn to their ancestors. Not one of all their enemies could stand against them; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} handed all their enemies over to them.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave them rest and safety on every side, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had promised their ancestors with an oath. None of their enemies was able to stand up to them. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave them victory over all their enemies.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawapa raha pande zote, kufuatana na yote aliyowaapia baba zao; wala hakusimama mtu mbele yao kati ya adui zao wote; adui zao wote {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwatia mkononi mwao.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa raha pande zote, sawasawa na yote aliyokuwa amewaapia baba zao. Hakuna hata mmoja kati ya adui zao wote aliyeweza kusimama dhidi yao; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwatia adui zao wote mikononi mwao.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa raha na usalama pande zote, kama alivyokuwa amewaahidi baba zao kwa kiapo. Hakuna hata mmoja wa adui zao aliyeweza kusimama dhidi yao. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa ushindi juu ya adui zao wote.

decisions.choice: gave them rest: freedom from war and from the threat of enemies
decisions.reason: Rest in the land was what the LORD had promised (Deuteronomy 12:9-10; 25:19; Joshua 1:13, 15). It meant settled life without attack, the goal of the journey from Egypt.

decisions.choice: not a man stood before them: no one could resist them
decisions.reason: To "stand before" an enemy is to hold one's ground against him. The words echo the promise of 1:5.

decisions.choice: gave into their hand: gave them victory over
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power: the enemies were put into Israel's power.

decisions.choice: rest and safety
decisions.reason: Adds "safety" to bring out what this rest was: freedom from attack.

source.text: לֹֽא־נָפַ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּל֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַכֹּ֖ל בָּֽא׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Not fell a word from all the word the good which spoke Yahweh to [the] house of Israel; the all came.

en.L: Not a word fell of all the good word which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken to the house of Israel; all [of it] came.
en.B: Of all the good promises {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had made to the house of Israel, not one failed; every one of them was fulfilled.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} had made many good promises to the people of Israel. He did not fail to keep a single one. Every one of them happened.

sw.L: Halikuanguka neno hata moja kati ya neno lote jema ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameiambia nyumba ya Israeli; yote yakatimia.
sw.B: Kati ya ahadi zote njema ambazo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameiahidi nyumba ya Israeli, hakuna hata moja iliyoshindwa; kila moja ilitimia.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ametoa ahadi nyingi njema kwa watu wa Israeli. Hakuacha kutimiza hata moja. Kila moja ilitimia.

decisions.choice: fell: failed, came to nothing
decisions.reason: A word that "falls" is one that is not carried out. The same saying returns at 23:14 and in Solomon's prayer (1 Kings 8:56).

decisions.choice: the good word: the LORD's promises of good
decisions.reason: "Word" here means what the LORD had said he would do for Israel: the land, rest and victory of verses 43-44.

decisions.choice: all came: all came true
decisions.reason: The verb "come" used of a promise means that it happened.

decisions.choice: promises
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name what the "word" was; Literal keeps "word".

decisions.choice: He did not fail to keep a single one
decisions.reason: Readable puts the LORD as the subject to make the plain sense clear: every promise he made, he kept.
